name: @auto-pigeon/operational-notice-contract
description: The operational-notice contract: AUB's bounded read response (auto-pigeon-operational-notices/1.0), the store's text and schedule rules, and the one client policy AUP, AUG and AUCOM share — server-time phase, visibility, per-revision dismissal, conditional polling with backoff, and a public-only cache. Contract data plus a dependency-free reference implementation — no transport, no UI, nothing that runs on its own.
